title: memoforge reviews/final-client-readiness.json
description: client-readiness-reviewer verdict for one draft version; `issues[]` doubles as the polish instruction list, so every issue carries a section_id (TZ v1.5 section 2.1 phase 14, section 4.1). `reasoning` MUST be emitted as the first key, as for the revision-loop reviewers.

draft_sha.description: sha of the version reviewed; export pins the verdict to it (TZ section 2.1 phase 14).

checklist.description: Binary grader items from lib/checklists/client-readiness.json; optional because the delivery review may run without a checklist file.

dispositions.description: D-211: one row per open substantive finding of the review loop (`state.open_substance_majors`, `origin: loop`) listed in the prompt. Optional: a report without open findings, or written before D-211, has none.

disposition.description: D-211, D-237: `polish` asks the polish pass to withdraw or soften the flagged statement (any class); `manual_review` hands the finding to a lawyer and lists it in the memo's Status section; `leave` (logic, counterarguments) keeps it for `summary.md`. An action the row's class does not allow counts as the class default.

issue_client.description: D-173a: one client-facing sentence in the memo language (only when it is not `en`).
